sources.title: qenneth/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-finetuned-for-ATC · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository contains a fine-tuned version of NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT-.6B-v3, optimized for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in air traffic control (ATC) communications. The model was fine-tuned using NVIDIA NeMo on the Jacktol ATC-ASR Dataset to improve recognition accuracy in noisy, domain-specific ATC environments.

sources.title: Air Traffic Control (ATC) Audio Transcription Pipeline - GitHub
sources.snippet: Features ATC Speech Recognition: Uses Parakeet-v3-For_ATC GGUF, fine-tuned for noisy ATC aviation communications. Noise Filtering & Reduction: Integrated high-pass filter (>100 Hz) and spectral noise reduction to handle radio background noise, carrier hiss, and cockpit interference.
